tasks.short: Recommend financial education resources to clients.

steps.what: Understand the client's actual budgeting, planning or credit question, language, access and learning needs
inputs: actual client question and learning context

steps.what: Find current approved educational materials for the actual financial topic, language and reading or access needs
Judge which resources are suitable and explain the recommendation to the client without substituting generic education for individual debt advice
Assemble and check the selected resource list, verified links and actual explanation for the intended client recipient
Send the exact approved educational resource message v1 to the approved client recipient

tasks.design: Configure {DOCS} filters for approved resource topic, language, accessibility and current version, then native selected-link insertion into {EMAIL}. The counsellor understands the need, chooses suitable material and writes the actual explanation; the complete checked message has its own send gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resource hunting and copying titles and links are repeated manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata filters and selected-link templates can reuse the approved resource register.
tasks.still_hard: Literacy, access barriers and whether education suits the client's situation need conversation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the client needs individual help rather than another leaflet.

ambition.what: No new financial advice or credit-decision authority.

tasks.altitude: Less resource hunting; judgement and client education remain.

reach.role: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
reach.task: Explain evidence and limits of an appraisal
reach.learn: Communicate what a source supports and where specialist judgement is still needed

evidence.claim: Native resource metadata filters and link insertion can support educational recommendations without choosing individual financial advice.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual learning-needs conversation, lookup, selection and resource-message delivery. Shares are provisional. It does not decide a debt plan or recommend a financial product.

The resource owner supplies approved title, topic, language, accessibility, locator and version/review date in {DOCS}. Missing metadata is read manually in s2. The counsellor produces actual needs and suitability judgement in s1/s3.

s4 reuses only selected titles and verified links; the counsellor captures the actual explanation and checks relevance and disclosure before approving the completed message. Native configuration comes first; no model is needed for a selected link list.
Edits void approval. Actual sending and existing runtime earn no saving. Any overlapping client conversation is allocated once in a team roll-up rather than duplicated.
unknowns: Resource register completeness and actual proportion of repeated link assembly
research_questions: Do topic and accessibility fields match how counsellors actually select resources?

already_counted.description: Capture explanation and check completed resource message

incremental.description: Maintain resource metadata, current versions and link checks

approvals.approved_version: educational resource message v1 and client recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 11.25 resource-search plus 7.2 link-assembly points less 1 upkeep = 17.45, high rounded down. Low assumes incomplete metadata and mostly bespoke recommendations; client understanding and suitability decisions keep full effort.

tasks.short: Review changed circumstances and whether a debt or budget plan needs revision.

steps.what: Discuss actual financial, family or employment changes and their practical effect on the client's existing debt, spending or budget plan
outputs: understood actual changes and client priorities

steps.what: Capture and reconcile actual changed income, necessary spending, debts, household circumstances and effective dates against supplied evidence
inputs: understood actual changes and client priorities

steps.what: Recalculate explicit budget totals and compare the checked changed figures with the existing debt or spending plan
Judge with the client whether changes to the debt management plan, spending plan or budget are needed and identify appropriate next steps
inputs: understood actual changes and client priorities
outputs: actual review decision and next steps

steps.what: Write and check the actual changed-circumstances review, decision, uncertainty and agreed next steps
inputs: actual review decision and next steps

steps.what: Save the exact checked plan-review note v1 in the correct internal client file

tasks.design: Configure explicit budget calculations and prior/current comparison in the debt-counselling case system in {OTHER}. The counsellor captures actual changes, reconciles evidence and decides whether revision is needed with the client; only repeated arithmetic is shortened and the actual review note remains human-authored.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff may recalculate the same budget totals and comparisons by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native explicit formulas and prior/current views can reuse checked amounts.
tasks.still_hard: Volatile income, essential spending, family pressures and workable choices require context.
tasks.human_edge: Understand whether a mathematically balanced plan is actually sustainable for this client.

ambition.what: No automatic plan revision or creditor commitment.

tasks.altitude: Less recalculation; the review conversation and revision decision stay with the counsellor.

reach.role: Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate
reach.task: Assess evidence underlying a changed property value
reach.learn: Distinguish an observed change from an assumed scenario when reviewing supporting evidence

evidence.claim: Native explicit budget formulas and prior/current comparisons can support a counsellor's changed-circumstances review.

assumptions: Boundary is reviewing whether a plan needs change, including actual evidence capture and the review note. Implementing a revised plan, client signature, creditor negotiation and payments are separate actions and receive no credit here. Shares are provisional.

The client supplies actual changed income, employment/household context and existing evidence; the counsellor captures amount, currency, frequency, effective date, essential expenditure and debt balance/terms in s2. Missing evidence is resolved manually within retained work; no bank feed is assumed.

The existing plan owner supplies prior checked figures and explicit calculation rules. s3 checks frequency conversions, completeness and reconciliations; rules compute totals, not affordability judgement. {OTHER} means debt-counselling case software, tested for native configuration before custom code.
s5 records the actual decision before save approval; edits void it. Same-system save and existing runtime earn no saving. Overlapping history or advice is allocated once across tasks.
unknowns: Current formula support and evidence completeness
research_questions: How much review time is recalculation rather than clarifying changes and sustainable options?

already_counted.description: Write and check actual review decision

incremental.description: Maintain frequency conversions and budget-comparison tests

approvals.approved_version: plan-review note v1 and correct client file

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 20 recalculation hours at 50% reduction less 1 upkeep = 9. Low assumes missing evidence and irregular amounts keep most calculation manual; conversation, actual capture, judgement and note authorship retain full effort.

tasks.short: Prepare client contracts and written financial recommendations.

steps.what: Check the actual agreed service scope, client identity, authorised terms and completed financial recommendation decisions for the requested document
inputs: actual service scope and recommendation decisions

steps.what: Prepare the contract or recommendation document's structured identity, amounts, dates and authorised standard clauses from checked instructions
Write the client-specific explanation of the actual financial recommendation, alternatives, limits and responsibilities without changing the authorised contract clauses

loop.purpose: Express the counsellor's actual recommendation clearly for the client
loop.input: checked recommendation decisions, rationale, alternatives, limits, responsibilities and structured document draft
loop.output: candidate explanatory prose around unchanged authorised clauses
loop.check: Counsellor checks the explanation preserves actual advice, trade-offs, uncertainty and obligations; all figures tie to checked inputs and no new promises or contract terms appear
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved meaning is written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Variable recommendation rationale needs coherent client-specific prose; a merge template cannot express the supplied trade-offs. Contract clauses and financial decisions are not generated.

steps.what: Review the exact completed client document v1, advice meaning, clauses, figures, intended internal record and client delivery or signature-request destination
Explain the actual completed contract or recommendation to the client and check understanding and unresolved questions
Save the exact approved client document v1 in the internal client file
Send the exact approved document v1 or signature-request package to the approved client recipient
outputs: delivered client document or signature request

tasks.design: Use native checked-field and authorised-clause merging from the counselling system in {OTHER} into {DOCS}. A bounded loop writes only the explanation of actual recommendation decisions; the counsellor reviews the completed version, explains it personally and performs separately gated save and client delivery or {ESIGN} request.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checked facts, clauses and client-specific explanations are repeatedly typed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates cover fixed content; a bounded loop can express supplied recommendation reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Sound advice, accurate obligations and genuine client understanding require human review.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when the document is technically correct but misleading to this client.

ambition.what: No automatic financial recommendation or contract execution.

tasks.altitude: Less document composition; advice decisions and client explanation stay with the counsellor.

reach.role: Agents and Business Managers of Artists, Performers, and Athletes
reach.learn: How to distinguish document wording from actual authority to commit a client

evidence.claim: Native clause/field templates and a bounded explanation loop can prepare documents from actual decisions with substantive professional review.

assumptions: Boundary is document preparation, explanation and delivery for contracts or recommendations, not making the underlying financial decision again. Shares are provisional across these document types; actual advice authorship is allocated to its own task once.

The counsellor's completed case decisions supply client ID, actual recommended actions, amounts/dates, alternatives, rationale and limits. The authorised policy/legal owner supplies current clauses and required notices. Missing or disputed content is manually resolved in s1-s3, not invented by the model.

Native templates are tested first. s2 handles structured content; s3 preserves authorised clauses verbatim and only expresses supplied reasoning. The counsellor captures any unrecorded rationale within retained s1/s3 effort.

s4 approves the completed document, record payload, client recipient and any signature-request details. Changes following s5 discussion return to review and void approvals. Client signature/acceptance and any required institutional countersignature remain actual separate work; a sent request is not an executed contract.
Ordinary saves, actual delivery and existing runtime earn no saving. {OTHER} means counselling case records.
unknowns: Who is authorised to issue signature requests and execute agreements
research_questions: Can generated explanatory prose preserve the exact financial trade-offs without adding promises?

already_counted.description: Capture rationale and correct explanatory prose
Approve completed advice/contract document and destinations

incremental.description: Maintain authorised clause versions, field mappings and explanation-fidelity checks

approvals.approved_version: client document package v1: internal document and destination
client document package v1: final document, client recipient and signature-request details if applicable

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 15 structured-document plus 8 explanation-writing points less 1.5 upkeep = 21.5. Low assumes bespoke clauses and complex recommendations need mostly manual preparation; actual advice, final review and client explanation retain their effort.

steps.what: Clarify the client's actual question and understanding of debt management services, programme rules or creditor concessions
inputs: actual client service or policy question

steps.what: Find and verify the current service rules, advantages, disadvantages and creditor concession policy relevant to the actual question
inputs: current approved service and creditor policies

steps.what: Explain the actual service rules, benefits, drawbacks and conditional creditor concessions and check the client's understanding
Write and check the actual services and policies explained, uncertainties and unresolved client questions in the case note
Save the exact checked policy-explanation note v1 to the correct internal client file

tasks.design: Configure current-policy filters by service, creditor and effective version in {DOCS} and the case system in {OTHER}. Show actual passages for the counsellor to verify; the explanation, understanding check and actual case-note writing stay human, with a separate unchanged save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current programme and creditor rules may be dispersed across documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source filters can narrow the correct current policy set.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining trade-offs and conditional concessions without promising acceptance requires judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise misunderstanding and explain a service's drawbacks as clearly as its advantages.

ambition.what: No automatic eligibility or concession decision.

tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; client understanding remains the focus.

evidence.claim: Native current-policy filters can shorten source navigation while a counsellor verifies applicability and explains trade-offs.

Policy owners and creditors already provide actual service/creditor identifier, effective dates, rules, benefits/drawbacks, conditions and source version. The counsellor produces actual question, explanation, uncertainty and understanding check in s1/s3-s4. No model-generated eligibility or financial advice is used. {OTHER} means counselling case software; native configuration is tested first.
